Thm 4(4), f := 'f/ker Theta (Nichols algebra B(V)). (a) injectivity: pi o Psi_phi = Theta o D_t for EVERY phi (Lemma 1), so Psi_phi^f injective whenever it exists with t in (k^x)^I. Corollary: for finite type and t in (k^x)^I, Psi_phi exists and is injective iff phi is a forced twist. No Rosso, no Lusztig 33.1.3.
